item.description:
Features

  • Break timer at the MacBook notch: see how many breaks you've taken today and a ring counting down to your next break right next to the notch. Hover it to start a break, delay it by 5 minutes or skip it, and swipe to see today's break stats. Turn it on under Settings > General > Menu Bar.

Bugfixes

  • Fixed the menu bar showing the previous time for about a second after a break or after changing the interval.
